title: FinancialObjectiveDetail
description: Per-call schema for the financial-perspective Round 2 elaboration. The `id` and `title` fields are NOT requested — `title` is provided to the call as input and `id` is assigned by assembly per Decision §2 of the optimize-strategy-map-latency design. Only the elaboration fields are emitted. `linked_opportunity_indices` was added in Phase 1b of `redesign-analysis-visuals` so the AI annotates each objective with the opportunities that would advance it.

linked_opportunity_indices.description: 0-based indices into the `opportunities` array shown in the prompt. List opportunities whose execution would directly advance THIS objective. Empty list when no opportunity in the list applies.
